blocks.text: Original document: [docs/SPLINE_CURVES_AND_EVALUATION_ARCHITECTURE.md](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/docs/SPLINE_CURVES_AND_EVALUATION_ARCHITECTURE.md). See [current limitations](/limitations) for concrete compatibility notes.
Smooth mathematical curves passing through or approximated by control points are foundational to scientific visualization, kinematic motion trajectories, and generative graphics.
Retiam provides a modular spline architecture:

items: **[`Spline`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/entities/primitives/2d/Spline.ts)**: A high-performance vector entity that inherits directly from [`Path`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/entities/primitives/2d/Path.ts), ensuring zero hierarchy overhead and native GPU anti-aliased extrusion.

items.text: **Evaluator Subsystem ([`src/engine/entities/primitives/2d/curves/`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/entities/primitives/2d/curves))**: Five dedicated mathematical curve algorithms implementing standard parametric formulations:

items: **Behavior**: Passes directly through all control points with $C^1$ continuity.
**Formulation**: For four consecutive control points $\mathbf{P}_{i-1}, \mathbf{P}_i, \mathbf{P}_{i+1}, \mathbf{P}_{i+2}$ and tension parameter $\tau \in [0, 1]$ (default $\tau = 0.5$):

blocks.text: B. B-Spline via de Boor's Algorithm (CurveType.BSpline)

items: **Behavior**: Smooth approximating curve contained within the convex hull of the control polygon. Degree $p$ (default $p = 3$).
**Recurrence Relation**: Evaluates basis functions using Cox-de Boor recursion over a non-decreasing knot vector $\mathbf{U} = \{u_0, u_1, \dots, u_m\}$:
**Behavior**: Continuous second derivatives ($\mathbf{S}''(x)$ is continuous everywhere) with zero curvature at endpoints ($\mathbf{S}''(x_0) = \mathbf{S}''(x_n) = 0$).
**Solver**: Sets up a tridiagonal linear system $\mathbf{A}\mathbf{D} = \mathbf{B}$ solved in $O(n)$ time via the Thomas algorithm, eliminating angular kinks under high magnification.
**Behavior**: Interpolates points given explicit tangent vectors $\mathbf{m}_0, \mathbf{m}_1$ at the boundary:

blocks.text: Unlike conventional graphics libraries that re-serialize path commands into SVG strings (`"M ... C ..."`), Retiam's `Spline` updates geometry in-place:

items: **Raw Numeric Buffers**: The evaluator writes directly into contiguous `Float32Array` or numeric contour arrays (`number[][]`).

**Dynamic Invalidation**: Calling `spline.setPoints(newPoints)` uploads modified vertices straight to the GPU VBO/IBO buffers, allowing 60 FPS real-time spline deformation inside `scene.always(() => ...)`.
